chunks: And it is narrated from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah that he said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام sent a man to Ziyād ibn ʿUbaydillāh and said: "Appoint this one to some of your work."

key_terms.عَمَلِكَ: your work; your administrative or practical task
key_terms.عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ: the named transmitter of the report

ai.seo_question: What did Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say about appointing a person to some work?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام sent a man to Ziyād ibn ʿUbaydillāh and instructed that he be assigned part of his work. The narration relates to employment, entrusted responsibility, and practical social dealings.
